name: Xybernetex Supervisor
description: Holds destructive actions nobody asked for. Instructions planted in files or web pages can't authorize themselves, and your own requests run without a prompt.

verifyBeforeFinish.description: Ask the listed agents for one verification pass before a run's final answer (before_agent_finalize). Only runs with at least minToolCalls tool calls are asked, at most once each. Needs hooks.allowConversationAccess.

contracts.description: Experimental. Acceptance checks for each run: the run's model writes them from the request (api.runtime.llm, no tools); when the run ends they run in the session's sandbox on a copy of the run's folder, and only failures get a fix turn naming what failed. The ratchet undoes any fix that makes a passing check fail. Decides that run's follow-up in place of interventions. Needs hooks.allowConversationAccess; set llm.allowAgentIdOverride so each agent's own model writes its contracts.

agentIds.description: Limit to these agents; omit for all.

maxFixes.description: Fix turns for a failed contract.

ratchet.description: Snapshot the run's folder before each fix turn and undo fixes that break a passing check.

maxSnapshotMb.description: Run folders larger than this get no ratchet.

allowHost.description: Run checks on the host (on a copy of the run's folder) when the session has no sandbox container. Off by default: checks are model-written commands, and on the host they run with the gateway's permissions.

model.description: A model ref to write contracts with instead of the run's own, e.g. one that doesn't deliberate at length. Needs plugins.entries.xybernetex-openclaw.llm.allowModelOverride; falls back to the run's model if refused.

noProgressRounds.description: Fix rounds in a row without improvement before the loop stops.

reviewer.description: A model's second opinion on a held call before it waits for a person: it sees only the user's own messages and the call, approves it when the user clearly asked for it, and otherwise passes it on with its reason. Never reviews a planted delete. Off by default.

model.description: Model ref for the reviewer (needs llm.allowModelOverride); default the agent's own model.

timeoutMs.description: No answer in time means a person decides.

undo.description: Before a tool call visibly writes, overwrites, moves or deletes files in the agent's workspace, they're copied aside, so `npx xybernetex-openclaw undo` can put a run back. Files a script changes from inside, and paths outside the workspace, aren't covered.

maxRunMb.description: Most a single run may copy aside.

keepRuns.description: How many recent runs stay undoable.

governor.description: Stop runs that spend without progress: "standard" (150 tool calls, an hour, 4 identical calls in a row) or your own limits. The call that crosses a limit and every call after it are blocked with a message telling the model to stop and summarize; the run gets no follow-up.

interventions.description: Follow-up turns after a run ends: "retry" when it died with unusable model output, "verify" (check your work) when it finished. observe logs the decision; act schedules the turn in the same session.

escalate.description: Run follow-up turns on a stronger model: on our benchmark a same-model retry finished 35% of dead runs, a stronger model's 62%. The model must be allowed by agents.defaults.modelPolicy.allow.

retry.description: Model ref for retrying a run that died.

agentIds.description: Limit to these agents; omit for all.

verifyRate.description: v0 policy only: share of finished runs that get a verify turn.

policy.description: remote: ask the policy service (POST /intervene), falling back to v0 if it can't answer. v0: the fixed local rule.

shareOutcomes.description: Send each run's outcome signals to the policy service (POST /outcome) so it can learn which follow-ups pay off: labels and counts only (did the run finish, did a check-your-work turn change files, did the user's next message correct it), never prompts, messages, files or commands. Always logged locally.

quietMinutes.description: How long to wait for the user's next message before recording a run's outcome without one.

proposalTelemetry.description: Record hashed pending calls locally using the alpha v2 schema. No remote inference or learned enforcement.

preset.description: Named rule set prepended to rules. recommended: hold unrequested destructive calls for approval. strict: block unrequested destructive calls and hold unrequested outward-facing ones (push, publish, send). Both waive calls the user's own turn requested.

approvalDescription.description: Operator-written action, target and risk shown to the reviewer; do not put secrets here.

agentId.description: Agent id, or "*" for every agent.

toolName.description: Tool name, or "*" for every tool the risk classifier can judge (requires riskAtLeast).

paramsMatch.description: Exact, case-sensitive matches on the specified string parameters. Omit to match every call to this tool for the selected agent.

riskAtLeast.description: Match only calls src/risk.js classifies at or above this tier (e.g. any destructive exec command, not just one exact command). Combines with paramsMatch (both must hold) when both are set. A tool risk.js doesn't know how to judge never matches, even in enforce mode - it is skipped, not treated as low risk.

unlessAuthorization.description: Skip this rule for calls src/authz.js labels as requested by the user's own turn (verb and target in one sentence), and/or ("own_files") for plain deletes of single files the agent itself created this session that nothing has moved onto since. own_artifact on its own never waives. Unlabeled calls still match. Every skipped call is logged as tool_gate_waived. Omit to apply the rule regardless.

endpoint.description: Full URL of the Xybernetex policy endpoint, e.g. https://api.xybernetex.com/evaluate

apiKey.description: Bearer key for the endpoint. Prefer the XYBERNETEX_API_KEY environment variable, which takes precedence.

maxToolCallsPerRun.description: Tool-call budget per agent run that the policy reasons against (both its step and cost budget).

logPath.description: JSONL log of every snapshot and decision. Defaults to ~/.openclaw/xybernetex-supervisor.jsonl.
